name: Family
supportLabel: Raspberry Pi website · main tools, OS downloads and documentation
notes: One family reference for Raspberry Pi single-board computers. Get Raspberry Pi Imager, official operating systems, hardware information and recovery documentation from the manufacturer. The community projects below cover gaming, media, home automation and networking; each project lists its own supported Pi models.

supportRoutes.name: Recalbox
supportRoutes.description: Turn a supported Pi into a retro gaming console. The project publishes Pi 4/400 and selected Pi 5 images; choose your exact board on its website.

supportRoutes.name: LibreELEC
supportRoutes.description: A small Kodi-focused OS with Raspberry Pi builds. Use the image for the exact Pi model.

supportRoutes.name: Home Assistant
supportRoutes.description: Run a home automation hub on a Pi. The official appliance guide targets Pi 4 and Pi 5 with at least 2 GB RAM.

supportRoutes.name: Pi-hole
supportRoutes.description: Run network-wide DNS filtering on a Pi with a supported Linux OS, or in a container. This is an application rather than a replacement OS.
